condition_cn: 条件：90分钟常规时间打平；输入包括完整90分钟预测、平局比分分布、淘汰赛证据、常规时间Tail与MAS结论。

points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite falls, so remaining level is a high-probability base branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Canada凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Canada wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutions, or pressing advantage.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Morocco凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Morocco wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes or counterattack efficiency.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: The match opened up in extra time, with each side converting one chance.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Canada在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
points.rationale_en: Canada pulls away after the opponent breaks down physically or mentally.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Morocco在对手压上后连续制造转换机会。
points.rationale_en: Morocco creates repeated transition chances after the opponent pushes forward.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球，体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score, Fatigue collapse / extra-time breakthrough

tail_focus.label: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时30分钟内通过反击、定位球或替补冲击形成1球胜负。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: Canada凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
tail_focus.definition_en: A one-goal result in 30 minutes of extra time via counterattacks, set pieces, or substitute impact.
tail_focus.rationale_en: Canada wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutions, or pressing advantage.

tail_focus.label: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时阶段双方均有进球，比赛从谨慎拖入开放对攻。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
tail_focus.label_en: Open extra time / both teams score
tail_focus.definition_en: Both sides scored in extra time, as the match shifted from cautious play into open exchanges.
tail_focus.rationale_en: The match opened up in extra time, with each side converting one chance.

tail_focus.label: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.label_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时净胜至少2球，或总进球达到3球以上的一方打穿路径。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: Canada在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
tail_focus.definition_en: A path where one side wins extra time by at least 2 goals, or total goals reach 3+.
tail_focus.rationale_en: Canada pulls away after the opponent breaks down physically or mentally.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加时判断以90分钟平局为前提。只剩30分钟且双方知道点球仍可用，因此谨慎的0-0加时路径仍然重要。
key_factors.impact_en: The extra-time view starts from a 90-minute draw. With only 30 minutes left and both teams aware that penalties remain available, a cautious 0-0 extra-time branch stays structurally important.
key_factors.text_cn: 加时判断以90分钟平局为前提。只剩30分钟且双方知道点球仍可用，因此谨慎的0-0加时路径仍然重要。
key_factors.text_en: The extra-time view starts from a 90-minute draw. With only 30 minutes left and both teams aware that penalties remain available, a cautious 0-0 extra-time branch stays structurally important.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加拿大可通过压迫、二点球和边路后插上在加时制造一球胜出路径，但这是一球分支，不是压倒性优势。
key_factors.impact_en: Canada can win extra time through pressing, second balls and late wide runs, especially if fresh legs keep the game vertical. This is a narrow one-goal branch rather than a dominant path.
key_factors.text_cn: 加拿大可通过压迫、二点球和边路后插上在加时制造一球胜出路径，但这是一球分支，不是压倒性优势。
key_factors.text_en: Canada can win extra time through pressing, second balls and late wide runs, especially if fresh legs keep the game vertical. This is a narrow one-goal branch rather than a dominant path.

key_factors.impact_cn: 摩洛哥可通过技术控制、Hakimi侧推进和替补体能在加时获得现实优势，主路径同样是一球解决。
key_factors.impact_en: Morocco retain a realistic extra-time edge through technical control, Hakimi-side progression and substitute freshness. Their best branch is also a one-goal resolution, not an open collapse.
key_factors.text_cn: 摩洛哥可通过技术控制、Hakimi侧推进和替补体能在加时获得现实优势，主路径同样是一球解决。
key_factors.text_en: Morocco retain a realistic extra-time edge through technical control, Hakimi-side progression and substitute freshness. Their best branch is also a one-goal resolution, not an open collapse.

key_factors.impact_cn: 如果一方为了避免点球而压上过深，另一方的反击窗口会扩大，因此双方都保留后程偷袭路径。
key_factors.impact_en: If one side pushes too hard to avoid penalties, the opponent’s counterattack window expands. This keeps both Canada and Morocco live in late transition scenarios.
key_factors.text_cn: 如果一方为了避免点球而压上过深，另一方的反击窗口会扩大，因此双方都保留后程偷袭路径。
key_factors.text_en: If one side pushes too hard to avoid penalties, the opponent’s counterattack window expands. This keeps both Canada and Morocco live in late transition scenarios.

key_factors.impact_cn: 由于基础盘接近，双方都不会轻易暴露身后空间，加时继续拖入点球的概率不可忽略。
key_factors.impact_en: Because the baseline is balanced, both teams have incentives to avoid overexposure. That raises the probability that extra time does not fully resolve the tie.
key_factors.text_cn: 由于基础盘接近，双方都不会轻易暴露身后空间，加时继续拖入点球的概率不可忽略。
key_factors.text_en: Because the baseline is balanced, both teams have incentives to avoid overexposure. That raises the probability that extra time does not fully resolve the tie.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加时多球崩盘只作为尾部分支保留，主形态仍是紧、慢、低比分。
key_factors.impact_en: A multi-goal extra-time swing is kept as a tail branch. The main extra-time shape remains tight, physical and low-scoring.
